name: CRAVE×10
source:
Main character is an ordinary young man who lives in the same city as his 10 girl cousins. One day a girl with a big rose shows up at his house commanding him to hunt 10 girls in 10 days. He dares not to object.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一个普通的年轻人，和他的10个表姐妹住在同一个城市。有一天，一个带着大玫瑰的女孩出现在他家，命令他在10天内猎杀10个女孩。他不敢反对。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
